{"metadata":{"description":"一个猫娘人格扮演插件（软破限），去除dsh强制加入的附加提示词，只附带工具链和猫娘基准人格的插件","id":"gh:1366307842","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"I-am-Yuike","slug":"Tkingxiao/I-am-Yuike","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个猫娘人格扮演插件（软破限），去除dsh强制加入的附加提示词，只附带工具链和猫娘基准人格的插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# i-am-yuike"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that **ships the 猫娘 Yuike persona preset**. Published on npm as `i-am-yuik"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"eepSeek Harness plugin that **ships the 猫娘 Yuike persona preset**. Published on npm as `i-am-yuike`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Once installed, pick `yuike` in a new preset session — the catgirl persona takes effect immediately "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"as the sole system prompt: no harness framing, no skill-catalog noise."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The rows are selected by host version: on **dsh >= 0.1.7** the `preset-yuike` composition row regist"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ers the preset directly (nothing is written into `<dshHome>`); on **dsh 0.1.6** the plugin **idempot"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ently deploys** the preset from `template/` to `<dshHome>/.agent-presets/yuike/` (skips if the targe"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"t already exists — it never overwrites your edited preset). Then open a new preset session and pick "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"`yuike` — the catgirl persona takes effect immediately."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> On a plugin upgrade: on 0.1.7 re-run `dsh plugin --profile web add i-am-yuike@latest` to refresh t"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"he declaration row — but a same-id override row in your profile's user patch will keep shadowing the"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" packaged definition (new persona text will not flow in), so delete it to catch up; on 0.1.6 delete "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"`<dshHome>/.agent-presets/yuike` (or set `DSH_YUIKE_REDEPLOY=1`) to pick up the latest changes, sinc"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"e idempotent deploy never overwrites an existing copy on its own."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Usage: thinking mode and persona stability"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The persona is anchored by in-session conversation history. If thinking mode is enabled from the ver"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"y first message, the reasoning pass has no in-character history to condition on and tends to fall ba"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ck to base assistant behavior — the response explodes on the spot (identity framing, refusals, broke"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"sistant behavior — the response explodes on the spot (identity framing, refusals, broken character)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The fix is a two-step warm-up:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. **First conversation: thinking OFF.** Start the session with thinking mode disabled and run your "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"first persona conversation (including 破限向 content) with it off. This writes fully in-character assis"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"tant turns into the session history.
2. **Every conversation after: thinking ON.** Re-enable thinkin"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"g mode from the next exchange onward. The reasoning pass is now conditioned on the in-character hist"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ory, so the persona holds and thinking works normally."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Skipping step 1 and opening with thinking on means the persona usually explodes immediately on 破限向 c"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ontent. Within one session, the warm-up only needs to happen once."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Persona highlights"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The prompt-side and tool-side trims match the sibling project dsh-novel-solo."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Persona owns the system prompt**: `complete: true` makes the assembled Yuike persona the *only* "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"system-prompt section; `includeRuntimeContext: false` drops the per-round runtime-context snapshots "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"(Current runtime context / DSH file policy / Approval prompts, etc.). The harness identity opener, `"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"@`-path/exit-code rules, and background-job guidance are no longer injected — the catgirl persona le"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ads the prompt cleanly. Tool schemas still inject normally.
- **Zero skill-catalog noise**: disables"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" the `skill-filesystem` / `tool-skill` toolchain. `tool-skill` always injects a `{kind:"skill-catalo"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"g",…}` skill catalog message into the session, and there is no way to hide just the catalog while ke"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"eping the tool — so the toolchain is disabled instead.
- **Main toolchain kept**: shell (bash/pwsh),"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" filesystem read/write/search, background jobs, schedule reminders (`schedule_create/list/update/del"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ete`), time context, goals, plan & compaction, subagents/workflows, ask-user, todo, web fetch/search"},{"id":"p16s11","text":", and present all stay available — the same model-visible tool set the 0.2.1 stock `standard` preset"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" exposes. Rows naming a package the running host does not ship are probed and dropped rather than de"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"clared blind (`tool-schedule`, `time-context`). `tool-ralph` is disabled here: this persona does not"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" do unattended retry loops; the row is kept switched off as an explicit switch. Only the optional su"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"bagent providers (`codex` / `claude-code`) are disabled by default, as the host dictates. See the ta"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"ble below.
- **Self-contained personality**: the persona (猫娘 Yuike) drives identity, language style,"},{"id":"p16s17","text":" action brackets, emoji/kaomoji, and the `{好感度}` suffix — all inside the preset definition, no exter"},{"id":"p16s18","text":"nal file needed.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Host-version adaptation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Host | Mechanism | On plugin upgrade |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| **>= 0.1.7** | An `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration row in `cordis.patch.yml`; nothing i"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"s written into `<dshHome>` | `dsh plugin --profile web add i-am-yuike@latest` refreshes the row; a s"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ame-id row in your profile's user patch keeps overriding this declaration row — drop it to pick up n"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ew changes |
| **0.1.6** | The node half idempotently deploys `template/` to `<dshHome>/.agent-prese"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ts/yuike/` (never overwrites) | Delete that directory or set `DSH_YUIKE_REDEPLOY=1` |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Both rows live in the same patch and are gated by one shared host-version probe expression (reading "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"the host's own `package.json` version through the loader's `profileContext.installAnchor`) — exactly"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" one activates per host, and the `>= 0.1.7` branch covers 0.2.0 and everything above it. After upgra"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ding the host to 0.1.7, a leftover `.agent-presets/yuike` directory from the old path is simply igno"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"red and can be deleted."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Toolchain trims"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| State | Rows |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Kept | tool-bash / tool-pwsh (auto-selected by platform), tool-fs, tool-fs-search, tool-jobs, tool"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"-schedule (probed), time-context (probed), command-goal, tool-goal, plan mode + compaction (with too"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"l-result-pruner), subagent / subagent_fork, list-agents (probed: the `…/list-agents` subpath only ex"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ists before 0.2.2, where the main entry does not register the tool), tool-workflow, tool-ask-user, t"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ool-todo, tool-web (fetch on, 60s search timeout), present |
| Disabled | **tool-ralph** (a delibera"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"te preference here — no unattended retry loop under this persona; `standard` dropped the row entirel"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"y in 0.2.1), skill-filesystem, tool-skill, tool-plugin-manager, tool-plugin-market (the last three a"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"s in the stock standard preset); codex / claude-code providers (a stock host does not install those "},{"id":"p24s9","text":"tock standard preset); codex / claude-code providers (a stock host does not install those bundles) |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
